articles.title: A Spacecraft Took a Selfie with Mars — and Caught a Secret in the Video!
articles.summary: NASA's Psyche spacecraft zoomed past Mars, snapping a month-long time-lapse video. The flyby gave it a gravity boost to reach a metal asteroid in 2029. Scientists even spotted Mars’s two tiny moons from far away!

articles.title: Sea Slugs Don't Need Paint — They Make Rainbow Colors with Tiny Mirrors!
articles.summary: Nudibranchs, or sea slugs, get their super-bright colors from stacks of tiny crystals under their skin. These crystals reflect light like a mirror, creating vivid hues without any pigment. Scientists found the slugs can mix red and blue dots to look purple!

articles.title: A Giant Ocean 'Conveyor Belt' Is Slowing Down — and It Could Make California Storms Wilder!
articles.summary: The AMOC, a huge Atlantic Ocean current, is weakening. New research shows this could make atmospheric rivers stronger along the California coast, bringing more floods. But Greenland might get less snow. Scientists say cutting greenhouse gases can help.
